_notice: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY — a representative, simplified stand-in for the shape of the production n8n workflows. This is NOT an export of the client's actual n8n workflows, and contains no real credentials, node configurations, or business logic.
description: Represents the pattern of the production system: multiple discrete workflows chained by triggers, rather than one monolithic workflow.

workflows_overview.name: 1. Batch Ingestion
workflows_overview.responsibility: Detect new Zillow batch file, parse rows, hand off property records to the next workflow.
workflows_overview.status: confirmed to exist; internal node config is illustrative

workflows_overview.name: 2. Duplicate Check
workflows_overview.responsibility: Check each property against persistence layer (Supabase) to skip already-processed properties.
workflows_overview.status: confirmed to exist; internal node config is illustrative

workflows_overview.name: 3. Qualification & Filtering
workflows_overview.responsibility: Apply pre-filter rules, run criteria analysis, classify Qualified / Not Qualified.
workflows_overview.status: confirmed to exist; exact criteria not recalled/reconstructed

workflows_overview.name: 4. Offer Calculation
workflows_overview.responsibility: Run deterministic JavaScript calculation node to generate two offers.
workflows_overview.status: confirmed to exist; exact formula not recalled/reconstructed

workflows_overview.name: 5. Report Generation
workflows_overview.responsibility: Generate Google Docs/PDF report with property, analysis, and offer details.
workflows_overview.status: confirmed to exist; exact template not recalled

workflows_overview.name: 6. Retell Call Initiation
workflows_overview.responsibility: Trigger Retell AI outbound call with property/offer context.

workflows_overview.name: 7. Call Outcome Handling
workflows_overview.trigger: Webhook from Retell AI on call completion
workflows_overview.responsibility: Receive transcript, analyze outcome, branch to appointment scheduling or rejection capture.

workflows_overview.name: 8. RAG Knowledge Ingestion
workflows_overview.responsibility: Chunk and embed transcript/summary, upsert into knowledge base for future retrieval.
workflows_overview.status: confirmed loop existed; exact ingestion mechanism inferred

workflows_overview.name: 9. Notification
workflows_overview.trigger: Called after Report Generation / Call Outcome Handling
workflows_overview.responsibility: Email client with generated report and result summary.
